title: Tenant export quarantine operator and admin compliance toggles (RBAC v2 + audit)
creator: Nina Patel
description: Add a tenant-scoped 'export quarantine' capability and admin-facing compliance toggles that integrate with RBAC v2 and audit logging. The feature exposes three modes at the org level (off, notify, quarantine). When set to 'quarantine', export attempts (CSV download, bulk API export, data offboard) are intercepted by a quarantine operator: exports are held, stakeholders are notified, and explicit approval (by an RBAC-permitted role) is required to release. The implementation must work across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments, record structured audit events, and honor SSO/SAML group-based admin mapping. This ticket covers API changes, console controls, runtime enforcement, DB migration, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Org settings page shows Export Quarantine mode with descriptions and toggle for admins mapped to 'security-admins' SAML group.
RBAC v2 supports a granular permission 'org:export:release' which allows releasing quarantined exports; default not granted to product admins.
Any export attempt when mode=quarantine creates an immutable audit entry with fields: actor_id, actor_email, org_id, export_type, object_count, request_id, decision_state, timestamp.

Quarantined export artifacts are stored encrypted with org-specific key and require explicit release via the API; release action emits an audit event and an email notification to configured stakeholders.
Automated end-to-end tests for Hosted and Dedicated flows demonstrate enforcement; Private deployment documented with required helm/agent config.
Canary rollout shows <0.1% latency change on export endpoints and no increase in error rates; rollback plan validated.
Console telemetry surfaces number of quarantined exports and average time-to-release in Redwood Console under the Org Security dashboard.
Security review completed and sign-off from Security team is recorded in ticket comments.
Dependency upgrades to RBAC v2 auth library are merged and released (see dependencies).
tech_notes: Design: Add org_settings.export_quarantine_mode ENUM(off, notify, quarantine) and org_settings.export_quarantine_policy JSON blob for stakeholders list and retention days.

RBAC changes: Add permission 'org:export:release' and 'org:export:configure'. Integrate with RBAC v2 evaluation path; permission can be mapped from SAML groups (security-admins -> org:export:release).

Enforcement points: API gateway middleware (hosted), coordinator service (dedicated), and private agent plugin must check org settings prior to allowing export. If mode=quarantine, persist request artifact to quarantine store and return 202 with request_id and status 'quarantined'.
Quarantine store: use S3-compatible bucket (or local FS for on-prem) with server-side encryption; metadata stored in exports.quarantine table (export_id PK) referencing org_id and object manifest.

Audit logging: extend structured audit event schema with 'export_quarantine' namespace; events emitted to internal event bus and to org audit logs retention path. Ensure events are immutable and include policy_version.
SSO/SAML: map external IdP groups -> RBAC v2 roles during login provisioning. Require at least one admin in 'security-admins' group for org to toggle quarantine setting by default.
KMS: tangent to export encryption — use org KMS key for encrypting artifacts; if key missing, block release and surface operator alert.
Backward compatibility: Support existing export endpoints by adding feature-flag 'org_export_quarantine_v2' and sticky rollout via org feature flags.
Migration: DB migration adds column + backfill based on orgs with existing export_lock flags. Migration to be run in a transactional, low-RPS window.
Observability: emit metrics 'exports.quarantined.count', 'exports.quarantine.release.latency', and create Console dashboard panel.
Private deploy notes: add helm chart values 'orgExportQuarantine.enabled=true' and instructions for connecting to KMS/HSM in on-prem doc.
Performance: intercepts are lightweight; artifact storage is async to keep request latency bounded. Use background worker to materialize artifacts and notify stakeholders.
Fail-open/closed semantics: in Hosted/Dedicated default to fail-closed (block export) when quarantine subsystem returns error; in Private allow config flag to choose fail-open vs fail-closed.
Data retention: quarantined artifacts retained for 'quarantine_retention_days' then auto-deleted; retention enforced by background cleaner with audit events emitted on deletion.

API contracts: POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/exports -> returns {request_id, status} ; GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/exports/{request_id} -> shows state (quarantined|released|denied). Release endpoint: POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/exports/{request_id}/release requires 'org:export:release'.
Security hardening: rate-limit release attempts and add anomaly detection for mass export requests; log suspicious patterns to security incident stream.
Docs: Confluence design doc and Console UX mockups linked; update public API changelog.
Note: coordinate with Legal for high-risk customer workflows (regulated exports).
migration_plan: Stage 1: DB migration - add org_settings.export_quarantine_mode and exports.quarantine table. Run in maintenance window with low write volume.
Stage 2: Ship RBAC v2 permission additions and feature flag 'org_export_quarantine_v2' default off.
Stage 3: Enable feature flag for internal orgs -> run integration tests -> enable telemetry.
Stage 4: Canary enable for 5% of new signups and selected enterprise customers, monitor metrics for 48h.
Stage 5: Full rollout and deprecate legacy export_lock flags after 30 days of stable metrics.
Rollback: remove feature-flag and revert to legacy export behavior; ensure background worker marks quarantined artifacts for deletion if rollback.
DB backfill: set mode=notify for orgs with recent admin toggles, otherwise off.
Notify customers: update Admin changelog and send targeted emails to customers with high export activity.
Private deployment docs: add clear upgrade path with preflight checks for KMS connectivity.
Operational runbook: add steps to investigate stuck quarantines and to manually release artifacts via internal ops UI.
testing_plan: Unit tests for RBAC evaluation including SAML group role mapping.
Integration test that simulates export flow in quarantine mode and verifies audit events and artifact encryption.
E2E tests for Console toggle and release workflow using a test org and seeded users.
Load test with synthetic export bursts to ensure background worker throughput and measure release latency percentiles.
Security fuzz tests for malformed export manifests and access control bypass attempts.
Manual QA checklist: validate email notifications, validate private helm settings, validate key rotation impact on release.
Scenarios for permission edge-cases: delegated admins, service accounts, and cross-org operators.
Smoke test to ensure no regressions on small exports (<100 rows) latency-sensitive endpoints.
Automated regression gates in CI to block merge if audit events are not emitted.
Acceptance sign-off by Security (Avery Ross) and PM (Lara Gómez).
